action.new_text:
# validate input
    if counts is None:
        raise ValueError("counts must not be None")
    counts = np.asarray(counts)
    if counts.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("counts must be 2D")
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be in [1, n_cells-1]")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(counts)):
        raise ValueError("counts contains nonfinite values")
    if np.any(counts < 0):
        raise ValueError("counts contains negative values")
    row_sums = np.asarray(counts.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    if not np.all(row_sums > 0):
        raise ValueError("counts contains all-zero cell rows")
    d = 1.0 / np.sqrt(row_sums)
    from scipy.sparse.linalg import LinearOperator, eigsh
    n = n_cells
    def matvec(v):
        temp = d * v
        temp = np.dot(counts.T, temp)
        temp = np.dot(counts, temp)
        return d * temp
    op = LinearOperator((n, n), matvec=matvec, dtype=counts.dtype)
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(op, k=n_components, which='LM')
    idx = np.argsort(-eigenvalues)
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[idx]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, idx]
    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
